notes: Two entries near the top of this log were listed as though they were older than they are. They arrived after "The Reach remembers the places you have found", but sat underneath it, so the log told you the wrong order of events. They now read in the order they actually happened.
Four entries in total named a build that was never released at all. Each one now names the release that genuinely contains it, checked against the release history rather than taken on trust.
Still to do: seventeen of the oldest entries all arrived in the same two builds. They cannot each carry that name, so what the log should say for them is still an open question.
title: The dev log puts its newest entries back in the right order
